channel.title: Morning Brief
channel.description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
channel.itunes:author: Morning Brief

item.title: Morning Brief — Sunday, 13 September 2026
item.description: Today: a major AI-agent attack campaign compromises 440+ PaperCut servers worldwide while sandbox flaws surface in leading AI coding tools; Australia weighs new gambling-ad reforms and a coastal flood-risk study; Queensland lands the Wallaroos and Rugby Sevens; and the Gold Coast's Coolangatta light rail extension is reportedly scrapped amid rapid population growth. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

item.title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 12 September 2026
item.description: Today: OpenAI, Google and Microsoft ramp up AI infrastructure spending while Anthropic discloses disrupted security threats; Australia mourns Blanche d'Alpuget and reacts to sliding PISA results; Queensland's credit rating is downgraded; and Gold Coast commuters face new rail closures from 19 September. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
